sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is an open 30B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in long-running AI agents. The model includes speculative decoding with multi-token prediction baked in during pretraining, plus DSpark and DFlash draft models for inference optimization across serving scenarios.
